source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Ιωνάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole entry is two sentences, and the second of them is the admission that there is no more: «Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου». That is a want of knowledge and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry; the page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The page names no see, so no see is named here**, and the English form carries the day rather than a place: it is not the corpus's `jonah-of-moscow`, whose day is 31 March and who died in 1461, nor `jonah-of-kyiv` nor `jonah-of-yashezero`. No hymn is printed.
